overview: A heavy AI-launch day. Google shipped Genie 4, its world model, as a research preview. Microsoft's image-editing model reached #2 on a benchmark. Matthew Berman called DeepSeek v4.1 Flash the best open-weights model. On the markets side, Kalshi and S&P Dow Jones Indices announced event-contract indices, Anduril and Qualcomm unveiled BlueChip, a US-built laptop, and Burry backed Ken Griffin's AI-bubble warning. Israeli election retweets and US culture-war posts are skipped.

top_items.title: Sundar Pichai - Google's Genie 4 world model is steerable in real time with native audio; trusted testers first, AI Ultra and Gemini API next
Tarek Mansour - Kalshi and S&P Dow Jones Indices will build indices of event contracts and list contracts on the S&P 500 and Dow
Palmer Luckey - Anduril and Qualcomm unveil BlueChip, a Snapdragon X laptop he calls the first American-built computer in decades
Matthew Berman - Calls DeepSeek v4.1 Flash the best open-weights model, saying the 1017 build is 'basically Opus 5.3 if it existed'
Mustafa Suleyman - MAI-Image-2.7-Preview ranks #2 in Artificial Analysis image-editing tests; MAI Cyber adoption doubled to 50% in 30 days
burrytracker - Says Burry backs Ken Griffin's view that AI is 'almost certainly' in a bubble, with chip overbuild risking a price freefall
Joe Lonsdale - Highlights an Anthropic and BigHat Bio therapeutics deal in which Claude helped optimize two novel antibodies
Elon Musk - Shares news that Starlink Mobile is live across Brazil with Vivo (50M customers) and United is adding Starlink to ~3 planes a day
